acceptance.text: Anonymous visible /:locale/help route renders localized content, all four FAQ disclosures expand, and the contact link reaches localized feedback in vi/en/ja.
At 390x844, every FAQ disclosure and contact link has a minimum 48px touch target, with no horizontal overflow; browser console and network have no page errors.

spec.expected_behavior: Public localized static help page with four interactive accessible disclosures and a feedback route; no auth or mutable API dependency.
spec.observed_behavior: Route, links, FAQ disclosure, and translations work in all three locales; mobile viewport has no overflow, but FAQ summaries measure 24px and contact link 36px.
spec.rollback_plan: Revert only the Help page target-size classes and its regression; no persistent data or schema changes.
